svg.title: Example with made-up inputs: claimed box value versus value you would use
svg.desc: Example with made-up inputs. Over three made-up months, claimed value totals 360 dollars and the value of items you would use totals 80 dollars. Not a real box.
svg.text: Example with made-up inputs: claimed vs used
Three made-up months. Not a real box and not an average.
Each month claims $120. Used value in the example: $25, then $40, then $15.
$25 + $40 + $15 = $80. The claim does not become your value.
Saving Optimizer. Example with made-up inputs. As of 29 Sep 2026.
